column1: # Quest IDs from the zhTW quest_template_locale "bracket-title" backlog. This list is
# now EMPTY. Discovered 2026-07-12: nearly all 61 remaining entries were a false
# alarm caused by a much larger bug -- a pending_db_world override had reverted
# 570 quests' zhTW text back to raw bracketed English even though base/db_world
# already had complete, real translations for all of them (same regression class as
# the earlier quest-11987/13843 fixes, just found to be ~100x larger in scope).
# Deleting all 570 bad overrides let base's real content take effect; see STATUS.md's
# "Recent fixes" section for full detail. Of the 61 entries originally tracked here:
# 54 were resolved this way, 6 were stale duplicates of entries already in
# skip-list.tsv, and 1 (11974, literal "[ph]" placeholder in its own English title)
# quests-no-wowhead-reference.tsv is retired as a category -- if a future check finds
# more Title/Details/Objectives gaps with no Wowhead reference, start a fresh list
# rather than assuming this file's old methodology is still valid; always check base
# vs pending directly first, since "no Wowhead reference" was frequently just this
# override bug wearing a different hat.
